explorer_spec.comparison_scope: all patterns have the same6s physical-time budget and include initial quiet/final coast; reset the same assembly before each trial
explorer_spec.failure_policy: malformed, missing, nonfinite, stale or invalid post-warmup readings and every nonempty motor fault_flags stop inference without mutating explorer state; native world remains authoritative for physical safety
explorer_spec.force_descriptors: RMS, peak and population standard deviation of the local specific-force vector magnitude, in m/s^2; includes gravity
explorer_spec.gyro_descriptors: RMS and peak of the local angular-velocity vector magnitude, in rad/s
explorer_spec.memory_scope: one trial; reset forgets all samples, identity and effort history
explorer_spec.paired_taps: 12 positive steps then coast through step49, 12 negative steps then coast through step99, repeated on the active clock
explorer_spec.pattern_clock: active time starts after initial quiet; final coast stops waveform requests for the last 15 steps

explorer_spec.push_and_coast: 12 positive active steps, coast, 12 negative active steps starting at step140, then coast
explorer_spec.sampling: unique delivered IMU samples seen after each20ms control transition; intermediate10ms samples are not reconstructed or double counted
explorer_spec.selection_or_ranking: none; fixed patterns describe observed responses without a reward score or optimality claim

shaft_governor.limitation: soft sampled-feedback envelope; not a guaranteed speed bound or hardware safety qualification
shaft_governor.rule: requested sign * min(requested magnitude, 0.35, 0.05 * max(0, 3 - requested sign * local shaft velocity)), then slew0.1

exposure: known development constructions; no frozen-v3 challenge exposure

protocol.contacts: disabled in this isolated planar fixture; no self-collision or ground
protocol.exposure: development-only construction; no old world, policy artifact, or heldout set

imu.axes: mounted segment local frame; no world orientation observation
imu.latency_rule: round nominal delivery up to the next .002s physics tick

protocol.motion_plane: XZ; anchored at origin; hinges about +Y; initially hanging toward -Z
protocol.motor_feedback_timing: synchronous local servo feedback at the step endpoint
protocol.power_supply: fixed nominal catalog bus voltage; energy recorded, battery depletion not modeled
protocol.reward: only the mounted IMU votes using unchanged imu_6axis_v0 reward and missing_reward

safety.imu: new construction_v1 supplemental veto: delivered sample reaches the catalog reward's hard acceleration-deviation or angular-speed threshold
safety.imu_threshold_scope: construction fixture only; no old world safety rule is changed
safety.motor: existing current, voltage, thermal and speed model; all flags retained
safety.numerical: MuJoCo numerical warnings, non-finite state or a simulator time reset fail closed
safety.veto_behavior: physical veto: zero powered torque, finish current .02s interval, require reset; numerical failure: abort immediately and require reset
